text:
morgan: Heads-up — I posted a short PRD draft for the degradation / tiering rules for smart request routing. asking for quick review before EOD: https://rwd.in/drive/degr-tier-prd :eyes:

sam: reading now. high level Q — are we prioritizing latency SLOs over model quality for standard tier fallbacks?

morgan: good call. the proposal prefers latency for user-facing sessions (standard) but keeps a quality floor (>=0.85 eval score). premium pins quality first.

jin: can you paste the compatibility matrix? small snippet would help the impl notes.

morgan: sure — short snippet below:
```
policy:
  - premium:
      prefer: exact_model
      fallback: none (route to reserved capacity)
  - standard:
      prefer: same_region_compatible
      fallback: cross_region_compatible -> quantized_variant
  - free/experimental:
      prefer: cheap_variant -> degrade_to_embeddings_only
```

lina: edge-case: what if same_region has only a higher-latency but higher-quality variant? we need tie-breaker rules (latency delta threshold).

carla: agree. propose: if latency_delta > 200ms prefer lower-latency variant unless quality delta > 0.05. add to ACs.

morgan: acceptance criteria (draft):
- AC1: For premium customers, no cross-region fallthrough unless explicit consent flag set.
- AC2: Standard tier must keep generated-text eval >=0.85 on our benchmark set after fallback.
- AC3: End-to-end latency P95 must not exceed configured SLO +200ms after fallback.
- AC4: Compatibility matrix coverage >=95% for supported models at launch.
- AC5: Rollout plan with canary to 5% traffic, rollback on quality/regression alert.

sam: tests we need:
- unit: policy resolution cases (same region, cross region, quantized fallback)
- integration: simulate region outage and assert routing rules and metrics emitted
- e2e: sample prompts for quality regression alerts

jin: small implementation note — KV cache invalidation when switching between model families. add as an edge case in the spec.

morgan: added, thx. also we should enumerate launch gates:
- compat matrix + model variants uploaded
- perf benchmarks for quantized variants
- canary automation ready (deploy-bot will handle)
- compliance review for cross-region fallback on regulated accounts

lina: deploy-bot — can you create a canary pipeline job name?

deploy-bot: created job `canary-degrade-routing-v1` targeting 5% of standard tier traffic, region-aware. link: https://ci.rwd.in/jobs/1234 :white_check_mark:

carla: prioritization note — customer A asked for guaranteed same-region for standard; that would require extra capacity/cost. propose backlog item: opt-in same-region dedupe for paying customers.

morgan: logged as backlog item and tagged customer A. final ask: please drop inline comments on the doc by EOD so I can finalize ACs tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
